title: Sichuan Chicken Lettuce Wraps
blurb: The chicken poaches with its own aromatics, then gets shredded straight into a sauce built around Sichuan peppercorns instead of a bottled dressing.
steps: Place the chicken, ginger and garlic in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook until an instant-read thermometer reads 160°F, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a cutting board (discard the ginger and garlic) and let cool 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk the sesame oil, soy sauce, vinegar, chili oil, peppercorns and sugar together in a medium bowl.
Shred the chicken and stir it into the sauce. Let stand 5 minutes.
Serve in the lettuce leaves topped with cucumber, carrot, scallions and sesame seeds.
